summary.description: Two high-severity issues: (1) 'ρ up to 0.50' is unsupported — no reported value reaches 0.50 (max ~0.48); this appears in 5 locations including abstract and conclusion. (2) Few-NERD N=16 LP selection '+0.52pp' references Appendix app:n_scaling which contains only SciERC data — the claim has no identifiable source. Three medium/low issues: oracle headroom rounding (13.0 vs 13.1), fig_selection_gap caption ρ discrepancy, and mean vs median convention mixing for within-instance alignment. One missing source: FK dependence range in method text.
